items.difficulty_reason: Both directions fully executed: forward - the topological map is continuous and open (named properties-of-stacks lemma), an affine open inside the component gives an irreducible image containing a nonempty open, and a closure containing a nonempty open is a component; surjective direction - choose a Noetherian open meeting the component, remove the other components, take the closure of an irreducible component of the preimage open, and conclude the equality of closures by construction.
